rules.applies: Every mercy the paladin knows applies whenever lay on hands heals a target.

options.name: Fatigued
options.text: Lay on hands also ends the target's fatigue.

options.name: Shaken
options.text: Lay on hands also ends the target's shaken condition.

options.name: Sickened
options.text: Lay on hands also ends the target's sickened condition.

options.name: Dazed
options.text: Lay on hands also ends the target's dazed condition.

options.name: Diseased
options.text: Lay on hands also works as remove disease at your paladin level.

options.name: Staggered
options.text: Lay on hands also ends staggering, unless the target sits at exactly 0 hit points.

options.name: Cursed
options.text: Lay on hands also works as remove curse at your paladin level.

options.name: Exhausted
options.text: Lay on hands also ends exhaustion.

options.name: Frightened
options.text: Lay on hands also ends the frightened condition.

options.name: Nauseated
options.text: Lay on hands also ends nausea.

options.name: Poisoned
options.text: Lay on hands also works as neutralize poison at your paladin level.

options.name: Blinded
options.text: Lay on hands also cures blindness.

options.name: Deafened
options.text: Lay on hands also cures deafness.

options.name: Paralyzed
options.text: Lay on hands also ends paralysis.

options.name: Stunned
options.text: Lay on hands also ends the stunned condition.
